in_hebrew.name: רוזvelt
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Roosevelt is derived from the Hebrew words 'rooz' meaning 'strong' and 'yald' meaning 'young one' or 'child'. In this context, it can be translated as 'strong one in the woods' or 'strong child of the forest'. The name Roosevelt may not have a direct biblical reference, but it embodies the strength and power of God in nature.

in_greek.name: Ροοσεβελτ
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Roosevelt is derived from the Greek words 'roos' meaning 'strong' and 'zeus' meaning 'god'. The name Roosevelt in Greek can be translated as 'strong one in the woods' or 'strong god of the forest'. The name Roosevelt may not have a direct biblical reference, but it reflects the power and strength of God in nature.

in_latin.name: Rosovaldus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Roosevelt is derived from the Latin words 'ros' meaning 'dew' or 'rosa' meaning 'rose' and 'vald' meaning 'rule' or 'power'. The name Roosevelt in Latin can be translated as 'strong one in the woods' or 'ruler of the forest'. The name Roosevelt may not have a direct biblical reference, but it reflects the power and strength of God in nature.
